_comment: What the demo exports. This file is the 'adding a model is a data change'
lever: a fourth candidate needs a render function and an entry here, not
new exporter code. `renderer` is a 'module:function' string resolved at
export time, so build_demo.py never imports a model it wasn't asked for.
Paths are relative to the repo root. Anything missing is SKIPPED with a
message rather than failing the run -- checkpoints, scenario_data/ and the
real bags are all gitignored, so a fresh clone can still build the parts
